actual_browser_scope: Two separate Chromium storage profiles; each WebSocket reached the deployed hive through a local TLS test bridge. Real software identities, proof and core enrollment were used; the invitation was supplied by the test harness.
actual_browser_outcome: Invitation expired before the first challenge received an acknowledgment. No comparison or installation was reached.
note: limited=0 is the local bridge counter, not a measurement of upstream rate admission. The bridge forwards frames unchanged in upstream mode.

minimal_probe.scope: Attempted protected EVENT exchange between two synthetic-group WebSocket connections; inspect the booleans for delivery. No application or physical-device acceptance claim.

local_checks: Same client completes enrollment through local TLS stand-in; fault checks cover dropped fragments/acks, duplicates, altered secret/endpoint and cancellation. 26 focused Node tests passed.
limitations: Cause of upstream missing forwarding not independently established
